text: {"brief_summary":"Example Co is a clinic group. It wants an app so patients can book appointments online instead of calling reception. It wants the app soon and wants it to work on phones. Reception staff should be able to see the bookings. The brief says more details will follow. It gives no information on budget, number of clinics or users, existing systems, booking rules, data protection or a target date.","technology_stack":{"title":"Technology stack for online patient booking","question":"Which kind of platform should the patient booking solution be built on or configured from?","context":"Facts from the brief: the customer is a clinic group, patients should book online, it should work on phones, reception should see bookings, and the customer wants it soon. The brief does not name a technology. Assumptions: the clinics probably already use a practice management or scheduling system. The solution will handle patient personal data, and possibly health data, so privacy rules will apply. The customer probably has little in-house development capacity. Because the brief is very thin, this recommendation is provisional and depends on the answers to the clarifying questions.","options":[{"key":"saas_clinic_booking","title":"Configured healthcare booking SaaS","description":"Subscribe to an existing online booking product built for clinics, ideally one that connects to the clinic group's current practice management system. Configure services, practitioners and locations, then embed or link it from the clinic website.","pros":["Fastest route to a working service, which fits 'soon'","Works on phones out of the box, usually with reminders and cancellations included","Vendor handles hosting, security patches and often healthcare privacy requirements","Little in-house IT skill needed to run it"],"cons":["Limited control over booking rules and the look and feel","Ongoing per-clinic or per-practitioner subscription fees","Depends on whether a suitable product integrates with the clinics' existing system","Patient data is held by a third party, which needs a data processing review"]},{"key":"microsoft_bookings","title":"Microsoft Bookings (Microsoft 365)","description":"Use Microsoft Bookings, with a booking page per clinic or practitioner and staff calendars in Outlook. Reception sees bookings in the Bookings app or in calendars.","pros":["Low cost if the customer already has suitable Microsoft 365 licences","Quick to set up, and the booking page works on phones","Familiar tools for reception staff"],"cons":["Not designed for clinical use, so it has no link to a practice management system","Limited patient records, intake forms and booking rules","May not meet healthcare data requirements without careful configuration","Bookings may need to be entered twice if the clinics keep another schedule"]},{"key":"power_pages_dataverse","title":"Power Pages portal with Dataverse (Power Platform)","description":"Build a low-code, mobile-friendly patient portal on Power Pages, store bookings in Dataverse, and give reception a Power Apps view. Use Power Automate for confirmations.","pros":["More control over booking rules than off-the-shelf tools","Faster to build than fully custom code","Fits well if the customer is already on Microsoft 365"],"cons":["Power Pages licensing for external users adds cost","Calendar logic such as slots and clashes must be built by hand","Integration with a practice management system still needs custom connectors","Needs Power Platform skills to maintain"]},{"key":"custom_web_cloud","title":"Custom responsive web app on Azure (optional native wrapper)","description":"Build a custom mobile-first web application with an API and database on Azure, plus a reception dashboard. Wrap it later as an iOS or Android app if a store app is needed.","pros":["Full control over booking rules, design and integrations","Can integrate deeply with existing clinic systems","No per-user SaaS fees"],"cons":["Longest and most expensive option, which conflicts with 'soon'","Customer owns security, hosting and healthcare compliance","Needs ongoing development and support capacity","Store apps add review cycles and a second codebase to maintain"]}],"recommended_option":"saas_clinic_booking","recommendation_rationale":"The brief stresses speed ('soon') and phone use, and it describes a common need: patients booking appointments and reception seeing them. A healthcare booking SaaS meets that need fastest, with the least build and support effort, and is likely to cover privacy needs better than generic tools. This is provisional. If the clinics' existing system has no compatible SaaS, or if the booking rules prove unusual, Power Pages or a custom build should be reconsidered.","assumptions":["The clinic group uses an existing practice management or scheduling system that bookings must stay in sync with (not stated).","A mobile-friendly website meets 'work on phones'; a native store app is not strictly required (not stated).","The customer has limited in-house development and IT support capacity (not stated).","Patient data is subject to healthcare or personal data protection rules in the customer's jurisdiction (not stated)."],"risks":["No suitable SaaS integrates with the clinics' current system, which would force double entry or a custom build.","Healthcare data protection requirements could rule out some vendors or hosting regions.","'App' may mean a native store app to the customer, which changes cost and timeline.","Subscription costs may grow with the number of clinics and practitioners."],"source_quotes":["patients can book appointments online instead of calling","They would like it soon and want it to work on phones.","Reception staff should be able to see"]},"delivery_approach":{"title":"Delivery approach","question":"How should the booking solution be introduced to the clinic group?","context":"Facts from the brief: the customer is a clinic group, which suggests more than one clinic, and it wants the solution soon. More details are still to follow. Assumptions: the clinics may differ in services, opening hours and how reception works. Moving patients from phone booking to online booking carries operational risk if slots or rules are wrong.","options":[{"key":"pilot_one_clinic","title":"Pilot at one clinic, then roll out","description":"Deliver a minimal booking service (book, see, cancel; reception view) at one clinic. Run it for a few weeks alongside phone booking, fix issues, then roll out clinic by clinic.","pros":["Gets something live quickly, in line with 'soon'","Problems with slots, rules or reception workflow show up at limited scale","Real usage data helps fill in the brief's missing details"],"cons":["Other clinics wait longer","Two ways of working exist across the group for a while","Needs a willing pilot clinic and staff time for feedback"]},{"key":"phased_mvp_all_clinics","title":"MVP for all clinics, then increments","description":"Launch a minimal feature set across all clinics at once, then add features such as reminders, intake forms or payments in later releases.","pros":["Every clinic benefits at the same time","Gives one consistent patient experience across the group"],"cons":["Configuration errors affect every clinic at once","Needs details from all clinics up front, which the brief does not yet have","Higher support load at launch"]},{"key":"single_release","title":"Single full release","description":"Gather full requirements, build or configure everything, and go live across all clinics in one release.","pros":["One go-live and one round of training","Scope is clear before work starts"],"cons":["Slowest time to value, which conflicts with 'soon'","Requirements are mostly unknown ('More details to follow'), so the risk of rework is high","No early feedback from patients or reception"]}],"recommended_option":"pilot_one_clinic","recommendation_rationale":"The brief asks for speed but leaves most details open. A small pilot at one clinic gives patients something usable quickly and lets reception workflows and booking rules be checked in practice before the whole group depends on them. This fits a clinic group, where differences between sites are likely. The recommendation should be revisited if the group turns out to be small or uniform.","assumptions":["The clinic group has more than one site (implied by 'clinic group', not confirmed).","Phone booking can continue alongside online booking during the pilot.","One clinic would be willing to act as the pilot site."],"risks":["The pilot clinic may not represent the others, so issues appear only at rollout.","Pressure for speed may push the pilot scope beyond a minimal set.","Running phone and online booking in parallel can cause double bookings if not synchronised."],"source_quotes":["The customer, a clinic group, wants an app so patients can book appointments online instead of calling","They would like it soon and want it to work on phones.","More details to follow."]},"clarifying_questions":[{"category":"integrations","title":"Existing scheduling or practice management system","question":"What system do the clinics use today to manage appointments, and must online bookings appear in it automatically?","why_it_matters":"This is the biggest factor in choosing the stack. If bookings must sync with an existing system, only products or builds that integrate with it are realistic, and double entry by reception must be avoided.","suggested_answers":[{"key":"pms_must_sync","title":"Existing system, must sync","description":"The clinics use a practice management system and online bookings must flow into it in real time."},{"key":"calendar_only","title":"Shared calendars only","description":"Appointments are kept in Outlook or Google calendars or similar; there is no dedicated clinic system."},{"key":"paper_or_none","title":"Paper or no system","description":"Bookings are kept on paper or in spreadsheets; the new solution would become the main schedule."}],"recommended_answer":null,"recommendation_rationale":"","source_quotes":["Reception staff should be able to see","instead of calling"]},{"category":"technology","title":"Native app or mobile website","question":"Does 'an app' mean an app downloaded from the App Store or Google Play, or is a booking website that works well on phones enough?","why_it_matters":"A native store app adds significant cost, time and maintenance. A mobile-friendly website can be delivered much faster and suits the 'soon' expectation.","suggested_answers":[{"key":"mobile_web","title":"Mobile-friendly website","description":"Patients book through a website that works well on phones; no download needed."},{"key":"native_app","title":"Native store app","description":"A downloadable iOS and Android app is required."},{"key":"web_first_app_later","title":"Website first, app later","description":"Start with a mobile website and consider a store app in a later phase."}],"recommended_answer":"web_first_app_later","recommendation_rationale":"The brief asks for speed and phone support. A mobile website meets both quickly, and patients rarely install an app just to book occasional appointments. A store app can still be added later if there is demand.","source_quotes":["They would like it soon and want it to work on phones."]},{"category":"scope","title":"Size of the clinic group","question":"How many clinics, practitioners and appointment types are in scope, and do they all start at the same time?","why_it_matters":"Scale drives licence costs, configuration effort and whether a single-clinic pilot makes sense.","suggested_answers":[{"key":"small_group","title":"Small group (2-5 clinics)","description":"A few sites with similar services."},{"key":"large_group","title":"Larger group (6+ clinics)","description":"Many sites, possibly with different services and opening hours."},{"key":"single_site_first","title":"One site in scope for now","description":"Only one clinic is in scope initially; others may follow."}],"recommended_answer":null,"recommendation_rationale":"","source_quotes":["The customer, a clinic group, wants an app so patients can book appointments online instead of calling"]},{"category":"business_rules","title":"Booking rules","question":"Which rules should online booking follow, for example which appointment types can be booked online, whether new patients can book, how far ahead, and how cancellations work?","why_it_matters":"Booking rules decide whether an off-the-shelf product is enough or custom logic is needed. They also affect clinical safety, for example whether some appointment types need triage by reception.","suggested_answers":[{"key":"simple_rules","title":"Simple rules","description":"Any patient can book any standard appointment type in open slots; patients can cancel online up to a set notice period."},{"key":"restricted_types","title":"Restricted types","description":"Only some appointment types are bookable online; others still need a phone call or triage."},{"key":"existing_patients_only","title":"Existing patients only","description":"Only registered patients can book online; new patients must contact reception."}],"recommended_answer":null,"recommendation_rationale":"","source_quotes":["patients can book appointments online instead of calling"]},{"category":"users_and_roles","title":"What reception staff can do","question":"Should reception staff only view online bookings, or also create, move, cancel and block appointments and slots?","why_it_matters":"The brief says only that reception should 'see' bookings. Editing rights change the staff interface, the permissions model and how online and phone bookings are kept in step.","suggested_answers":[{"key":"view_only","title":"View only","description":"Reception can see online bookings but manages changes elsewhere."},{"key":"full_management","title":"Full management","description":"Reception can view, create, change and cancel bookings and manage available slots."},{"key":"view_and_cancel","title":"View and cancel or reschedule","description":"Reception can view bookings and change or cancel them, but slot setup is done by an administrator."}],"recommended_answer":"full_management","recommendation_rationale":"Reception will still take phone bookings and handle changes. If they cannot manage bookings in the same place, double bookings and duplicate work are likely.","source_quotes":["Reception staff should be able to see"]},{"category":"non_functional","title":"Patient data and privacy requirements","question":"What patient information will be collected at booking, and which data protection or healthcare regulations and hosting location requirements apply?","why_it_matters":"Health-related personal data usually carries strict legal requirements. These can rule out some vendors and hosting regions and add work for consent, identity checks and data processing agreements.","suggested_answers":[{"key":"minimal_contact","title":"Minimal contact details only","description":"Name, contact details and appointment type only; no clinical information."},{"key":"includes_health_info","title":"Includes health information","description":"Reason for visit or intake questions are collected, so health data rules apply."},{"key":"unknown_needs_dpo","title":"Unknown - needs review","description":"The customer's data protection lead needs to confirm the requirements."}],"recommended_answer":"minimal_contact","recommendation_rationale":"Collecting the least data needed is common practice under data protection law. It reduces compliance burden for a quick first release, and more information can be added later after review.","source_quotes":["patients can book appointments online instead of calling"]},{"category":"constraints","title":"Timeline and budget","question":"What does 'soon' mean as a target date, and is there a budget range or a preference between subscription costs and a one-off build cost?","why_it_matters":"The date and budget decide between configuring a SaaS product and building a custom solution, and how much fits into the first release.","suggested_answers":[{"key":"within_3_months","title":"Within about 3 months","description":"A working service at least at one clinic within roughly three months."},{"key":"within_6_months","title":"Within about 6 months","description":"Live within six months; some custom work is acceptable."},{"key":"fixed_external_date","title":"Fixed external date","description":"A specific date is driven by an event, contract or staffing change."}],"recommended_answer":null,"recommendation_rationale":"","source_quotes":["They would like it soon and want it to work on phones.","More details to follow."]}]}
